## Summary

**Adopt a dashboard typography token system**

Titles, values, units, body text, tables and axes have inconsistent scale and auto-shrink.

## Priority / wave

- Priority: **P1**
- Wave: **V2**
- Complexity: **L**
- Audit code: `UX-P1-01`
- DUX code: `DUX5-10`

## Scope

All dashboards.

Screenshot groups: SG-01..SG-07 (systemic)

## Concrete change

Implement the typography baseline in this report and forbid shrink below minimums.

## Expected effect

Consistent hierarchy and readable text across viewports.

## Acceptance criteria

- Automated screenshot checks confirm token floors; no panel title/body/table text below minimum at 1366×768.
- Aligns with epic acceptance: Status/Reason/Impact/Action visible without internal scroll on first viewport
- No new high-cardinality Prometheus labels
- No hidden verdict logic introduced only in Grafana transforms

## Dependencies

Grafana theme and library-panel conventions.

## Risk

Grafana native controls may not expose every token; document exceptions.

## Overlap / predecessor notes

Related to DUX4-40 token contract; typography floors + no auto-shrink below min.

## Constraints

- Surgical dashboard JSON only; preserve panel IDs where possible
- Run Explorer remains forensic owner when moving detail off domain boards
- Prefer description/runbook for caveats; keep first-screen copy to 2-4 lines
- Tech-debt budgets non-increasing

## Verification

- [ ] Before/after screenshots for affected panels (dark theme)
- [ ] Viewports: 1366x768, 1440x900, 1920x1080 at 100% (125% when layout-sensitive)
- [ ] Targeted pytest for navigation/contracts if JSON structure changes
- [ ] Manual operator 5-second comprehension check on first-screen card

## Parent

DUX5 epic (#7116)
